items.title: A Chinese AI company just connected its model to Wall Street's leading data providers
items.summary: BEIJING — The Chinese artificial intelligence startup behind the Kimi model said Thursday that financial industry giants, including investment banks, funds and venture capital firms are using its Kimi models on AI tools.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic are making 10 times more revenue than all Chinese AI models combined, research group Rhodium says
items.summary: BEIJING — China's artificial intelligence models may be enjoying rapid adoption but that isn't yet translating into revenue, raising questions about company valuations.

items.title: Here are five key takeaways from Wednesday's Fed rate hike
items.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday delivered a much-expected interest rate hike, and Chairman Kevin Warsh followed with a notably terse news conference at which he stressed policymakers' staunch commitment to tackling inflation.

items.title: Here is what changed in the new Fed statement under Warsh
items.summary: This is a comparison of Wednesday's Federal Open Market Committee statement with the one issued after the Fed's previous policymaking meeting in July.

items.title: Fed approves interest rate hike, signals one more to come this year
items.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday approved its first interest rate hike in more than three years and indicated another is to come, as part of an effort aimed at combating inflation brought on by spiraling oil prices and other factors.

items.title: Senate is still a toss-up, but Democrats now have slight edge, prediction market traders think
items.summary: The battle for the U.S. Senate is still tight, but prediction market traders think Democrats have close to their best chances yet of taking the upper chamber.

items.title: Bank of England defies Fed’s rate-hike lead, leaving rates unchanged
items.summary: The Bank of England left interest rates unchanged on Thursday, despite inflation rising well above its 2% target, but warned a hike was becoming increasingly likely.

items.title: 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices
items.summary: Transportation companies, the lifeblood of the U.S. economy , are flashing warning signs as diesel costs hit records.

items.title: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
items.summary: Consumers are facing a double-whammy of jumping oil prices and Treasury yields amid the U.S. war with Iran that is leaving them increasingly cash-strapped.

items.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.1% as energy costs soar
items.summary: The U.K.'s annual inflation rate jumped to 3.1% in August, pushed up by surging gasoline and diesel prices.
